name: Nonlinear Least Squares
summary: Infer unknown parameters by minimizing the sum of squared residuals between model predictions and observations.
core_idea: Solve min ||r(theta)||², with a nonlinear residual map generated by an ODE/PDE forward model or observation operator.
innovation: Provides an optimization-based inverse-problem formulation exploiting observation mismatch.
limitations: Ill-posedness and multiple local minima may obstruct recovery

start_here.why: Research-aligned comprehensive account of nonlinear least-squares inverse problems.
start_here.focus: Finite-dimensional formulation, observability, optimization, and well-posedness.
